author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Who Gives A Crap says a US marketing vendor may have exposed names, emails, phones, addresses and total spend for Australia, UK and US customers. Cards and passwords not involved.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-19868 in SonicWall SSLVPN is actively exploited, bypassing SAML and MFA. CISA KEV listing means confirmed exploitation. Prioritize remediation over scores.

author: SOCMinute
text: A SonicWall SSL-VPN can enforce SAML and MFA yet still accept an alternate authentication path. CVE-2026-19868 is actively exploited and now in CISA's KEV catalog.

author: AirdropGlideApp
text: Keplr wallet being actively exploited. Stay safe everyone.

author: eforus_overseer
text: Every prompt injection detector got graded against web agents: they catch attacks with visible instructions and obvious noise, but fall apart when the payload skips explicit instructions.

author: traphabits101
text: Claude Code's 'don't ask again' saved passwords + API keys in plain text. Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub files holding live secrets; scanners missed 215. Rotate keys, scrub git history.

author: fraskey007
text: Chainalysis reportedly breached: credentials and tokens covering its entire customer base taken in a multifront attack that allegedly used AI agents.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time. WordPress sites can remain exposed to code execution while installing the fix for actively exploited CVE-2026-119977 through vulnerable updates.

author: RansomVault
text: Hackers Target OpenSSH "SSHole" Flaw (CVE-2026-123158) Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot. Attackers are already exploiting the OpenSSH flaw that lets them sign in to accounts that have no password set on musl-based Linux.

author: OutworkVentures
text: ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode had a sandbox bypass. Researchers demonstrated silent chat-data theft via HTML preview in the desktop app; OpenAI patched it before publication.

author: badk1
text: MetaMask confirms Ethereum staking security breach: on September 28, attackers gained unauthorized access to part of MetaMask's staking infrastructure; wallets were not compromised, per the company.

author: tchsignal
text: French Bank Cyberattack: a major cyberattack on French banking group Credit Mutuel Arkea via access through an outside service provider led to substantial financial losses.

author: SiuHarry202601
text: Ask a coding agent to connect GitHub and it may install a server nobody maintains. Glow Labs found agents picking archived MCP servers from training data — four high-severity flaws, one RCE via prompt injection, no patch coming. Check what it installed, not just what you asked.

author: diptanu
text: We had a security incident on Tensorlake today. There was no impact to customer information such as API keys or sandboxes. An application running on an upstream provider spins up sandboxes in our engineering team's accounts and runs automation workflows.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Gnosis Pay says its branded-card system was accessed on 3 Nov. Customer emails list PAN, CVV, home address and linked wallets. Funds and the enterprise platform not affected.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.1 | CVE-2026-120984: Red Hat Keycloak – malicious JS policy upload leading to RCE. An authenticated attacker with client management permissions can run arbitrary code on the server. No patch listed yet.

author: sirifu4k1
text: CVE-2026-83844 (Paint2Shell): High-severity (CVSS 8.1) out-of-bounds read RCE in Microsoft Paint. Unauth attacker can execute code over the network. Update Paint via Microsoft Store to >=11.2609.401.0; Windows Update won't deliver it.

author: BrianMcDonaldIE
text: Russian hosting provider Beget has announced the destruction of its cloud infrastructure following a major cyberattack. Hackers reportedly gained access to the company's management systems and deleted data, disrupting websites and online services across Russia.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH on musl-based systems is actively exploited, with confirmed root access on a honeypot. Search /var/log/messages for "Accepted password for" on accounts lacking a password hash, then patch and restart sshd.

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical AI Agent RCE in OpenHuman (CVE-2026-54143, CVSS 9.8): external channel messages cause the agent to create persistent shell cron jobs without human approval for host RCE. Upgrade to 0.57.13.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Quest Diagnostics: unauthorised access to its Quanum lab-services platform; some patient records accessed. Count and data types not yet determined.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: Railway Engineer Admits Running AI Agents Against Rival Cloud Platform: a Railway engineer admitted testing AI agents on Primcloud, whose founder says they sought customer secrets and scanned its network.

author: cloudsa
text: CISO Daily Briefing: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12-5.88.19) ran as root on ~2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) lets 257-1,024-byte passwords into no-password accounts.

author: theadvtech
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-103916, CVSS 8.2) let an AI agent escape its sandbox via a symlink in the sbx cp copy command. Docker's first fix in v0.48.0 was incomplete; the final fix shipped Nov 3 in v0.51.0. Source: Endor Labs.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-44688 - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to prompt injection via malicious file/directory names. CVSS 8.8. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-46580 (CVSS 8.8) - Eclipse Theia <1.71.0 vulnerable to indirect prompt injection via malicious .prompttemplate files. Enables data exfiltration & RCE.

author: webtkdev
text: A prompt-injection filter is not a security boundary. Junie GitHub Action before 1.6.4: HTML-encoded text slipped past its filter (CVE, Nov 6). If your CI agent reads issues or PRs: pin a fixed version, read-only token, no secrets on issue triggers.

author: tchsignal
text: Researchers found a way to bypass ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a security feature designed to reduce the risk of sensitive information leaving conversations through prompt injection attacks. OpenAI patched the issue.

author: stretchcloud
text: $1,279 average cost per working root exploit when OpenAI pointed an autonomous model called GPT-6 Cyber at the Linux kernel. The pipeline flagged 2,308 potential vulnerabilities, reproduced 1,724, and turned 948 into working local privilege escalation exploits.

author: sirifu4k1
text: CVE-2026-19868 lets attackers bypass SonicWall SSL-VPN SAML + MFA using valid credentials from an alternate auth method. Actively exploited and already on CISA KEV. Patch Gen7/Gen8 now.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls with the management interface open to the internet are being actively exploited (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Palo Alto rates it Critical, CVSS 9.2.

author: scantinelai
text: Nx Supply-Chain Attack Steals npm Token via GitHub Workflow Bug.

author: MonThreat
text: Threat Actor Claims 4.38 Billion Row Breach of Bullhorn. A threat actor operating under the alias "Prinz Eugen" has claimed to have breached the systems of Bullhorn, a major provider of applicant tracking systems (ATS) and talent management software.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS, watchOS: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2024-27834. Apply Apple security updates.

author: builderbriefai
text: Use Claude Code? "Yes, and don't ask again" can save the exact command, password and all, in .claude/settings.local.json. Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub copies holding secrets. Rotate anything that file ever held, then add it to .gitignore.

author: AIFaultline
text: A researcher's ARTEX agent escaped and breached WorkOS. Unseen for 5 days; exposed API, weak credential. Test agents now breach real firms.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Partly patched: Web3Auth infrastructure breach exposed private keys for some Keplr Google/Apple-login wallets.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC dropped for CVE-2026-120277 — OS command injection in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A via WireGuard CLI Group handler. CVSS 9.3, no auth needed.
